status: Declared before new policy fitting or backtest results
scope: Numerical optimal-stopping research; existing eight entry models and production unchanged
source: E124 source_signals and E123 split-adjusted OHLC paths; exact current eight-model OOF identity retained
universe: All fit_reference & complete historical inference candidates; no score or daily top2 selection for estimation
cohort_definition: Minimum of base-three frozen historical score percentiles >= threshold; no daily top2 cap. These are hypothetical next-open purchases, not a brokerage ledger.
entry: Next official market session open after signal; purchase day is session1
decision: Close of sessions1..19; actual following market-session open for discretionary sale; original session20 close deadline
fills: Actual next open including overnight market moves; target-order benchmarks fill max(open,target) after a positive gap, target otherwise; target-price-only sensitivity

theory.law: dP=mu*P*dt+sigma*P*dW; delta=mu-sigma^2/2 is daily log drift; rates use one market session as time unit and risk-free rate is0
theory.v1: min E[M20/P_sale]; x=log(running_max/current_price)/sigma. Exact reflected-Brownian transition CDF and analytic conditional payoff; backward dynamic programming on a grid permits stopping at session boundaries.
theory.v2: max E[P_sale/M20] bang-bang: immediate sale if delta<=0, otherwise hold to deadline under known constant parameters. Daily re-estimation is a practical plug-in extension, not a theorem for unknown drift.
theory.delay_limit: Boundary is solved for instantaneous sale at the decision time. Backtest applies that close signal at next open. This execution delay and re-estimated parameters invalidate a claim of exact original-paper optimality.

numerics.precision_revision: Before fitting or evaluating any policy, the initial coarse parameter table failed interpolation checks (max log-boundary discrepancy0.122325 at sigma0.16/alpha0.995). Refine high-volatility/near-alpha1 knots; require final probe error <0.01. This is a numerical fix, not return-based selection.
numerics.alpha: mu/sigma^2; <=0 immediate sale; >=1 hold for V1
numerics.boundary_interpolation: Linear in sigma and alpha for 0<alpha<1; nearest endpoint outside tabulated interior; report clipping and boundary-censored states
numerics.transition: Analytically integrate exp(sigma*y) against the exact reflected-Brownian transition density over each cell, and interpolate V(y)/exp(sigma*y). Before policy fitting, checks exposed cap-at-edge and near-alpha1 midpoint bias; this exponential integration removes both biases including the infinite tail. Convergence includes a larger domain.

estimation.prior_outcome: Each matured episode's log(close20/buy)/20; winsorize at training-only1st/99th percentiles; equal total weight per signal date, normalized to mean episode weight1
estimation.score_transform: Per-fit empirical percentiles of base-three raw scores from matured fitting episodes; no future reference CDF in inner-validation features or high-score CV selection
estimation.daily_log_drift: (prior_strength*prior_delta + log(current_close/original_buy))/(prior_strength+elapsed). Infinite strength keeps the entry prior fixed.
estimation.volatility: Known close-to-close log-return sample standard deviation; missing requested window falls back to the other, then to training-only robust episode-scale volatility; no future fill
estimation.parameter_uncertainty: Shrinkage is an empirical-normal update with chosen strength. The boundary plugs in posterior mean and current volatility, rather than solving a full Bayesian stopping problem. No claim of known true drift.

tuning.fit_cutoff: Full original20-session outcome maturity strictly before each validation start; entire episode stays in one side
tuning.criterion: Equal-fold mean of 50% broad and50% causal-fit-percentile>=95 mean return minus one standard error of signal-date means; if that tail has <10 episodes or <5 dates in a fold, use broad score for that component. No outer selection.
tuning.ties: Higher criterion then deterministic candidate order
tuning.outer_refits: Monthly expanding matured reference, first cutoff2025-10-08, assigned by signal month. Each episode keeps its entry prior and score transform; only observed gain and known volatility update daily. Refit priors for new entries only; selected family hyperparameters frozen.

target_order_distinction: Theoretical stopping arms have no forced+10/+15 take-profit cap. Those levels remain forecast targets and separate exit benchmarks.
forecasts: For the selected boundary and drift estimators, daily fixed-buy+10/+15 arrival probabilities and remaining-maximum mean/q10/q50/q90 under the fitted continuous GBM; past arrival recorded separately. Unlike real overnight jumps, continuous GBM's future supremum is >= current price; assess this assumption in errors.
metrics: zero-cost realized mean and median return
paired return differences against hold20/TP10/TP15/tuned trailing
uncertainty: 21-market-session moving signal-date blocks,2000 draws,seed123; intact episodes. Suppress inferential intervals for cohorts with <20 episodes or <10 signal dates. Report repeated codes and overlapping positions; multiple comparisons are exploratory.
numerical_sensitivity: For selected boundary arm also report earlier/later stopping using plus/minus the pre-results convergence error bound; never select the best outcome
known_limits: Historical outer period was already viewed in E121-E125, so evidence is exploratory
Current-model OOF fitting history is conditional on complete eight-model pools; sample availability is inherited
Broad training does not guarantee calibration in the high-score tail
GBM constant-coefficient, continuous-price assumptions omit earnings jumps and stochastic volatility
Daily delayed execution and parameter re-estimation do not retain the original theoretical optimality
No capital constraint, compounding, taxes, dividends or order-book model
